export_entries_as_dduf: export a list of entries as a DDUF archive file with model_index.json and binary assets
export_folder_as_dduf: export a folder containing model files into a compressed DDUF archive
read_dduf_file: read a DDUF archive file and return a dictionary of DDUFEntry objects for each contained file
validate_dduf_entry_name: validate that a filename has an allowed extension and no nested directory paths
validate_dduf_structure: validate that a DDUF archive's entries match the expected structure from model_index.json
